summary: Brady Corporation filed this Form 8-K/A to amend its original August 6, 2026 report and supply the Item 9.01 financial statements and pro forma information omitted earlier. The filing confirms completion, effective August 3, 2026, of Brady's acquisition of Honeywell International Inc.'s Productivity Solutions and Services business under an Equity Purchase Agreement dated April 20, 2026. Exhibits include audited combined financials for 2025 and 2024, interim statements through June 27, 2026, pro forma combined figures, and Deloitte's consent. No purchase price, premium, or board recommendation is stated in this excerpt; watch integration and leverage risk.
